verdict.rationale: Founder Law is a law firm, but it handles sensitive client data, so asking whether that data is kept out of AI training is a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence pack has no data-use, privacy, or AI-training opt-out policy. The AI-posture statement contrasts automated legal tools with accountable attorneys and says nothing about how client data is used.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
